up: Retrieve all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1629474. For each compound, provide the following fields: compound ChEMBL ID, compound name (pref_name), maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Order the results by compound ChEMBL ID in ascending order. The compounds can be linked to the document via the compound_records table (doc_id) and then to molecule_dictionary (molregno), with canonical SMILES from compound_structures (molregno).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1629474' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
